candidate.answerReason: Using the stripe width as one unit, the square has area 36 and its three shaded L-shaped bands have areas 11, 7, and 3. Their fraction of the whole is 21/36=7/12.

methods.label: Subtract nested square areas
methods.explanation:
Each shaded stripe is an L-shaped region that can be found by subtracting one square from a larger square. Use the common stripe width as one unit of length. Changing the unit does not change the shaded fraction.

The scale drawing shows six stripe widths along each side, so the whole square has area \(6\cdot6=36\). Starting with the outermost shaded stripe, the three shaded areas are
\[
6^2-5^2=11,\qquad
4^2-3^2=7,\qquad
2^2-1^2=3.
\]
Each difference removes the smaller square sharing the lower-left corner, leaving exactly one shaded L. These three regions do not overlap and together contain all the shading. Their total area is \(11+7+3=21\), so the shaded fraction is
\[
\frac{21}{36}=\boxed{\frac7{12}}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
